governance_rules.provisional_policy_clarification: Dual-policy specification: 1) Static Archive Quarantine: The parquet is_provisional boolean flags the trailing L rows (12h waves, 24h currents) anchored to the end of the file (file_end_time_utc - operational_lag) for conservative batch training quarantine. 2) Operational Serving Cutoff: Live inference dynamically computes cutoff_utc = issue_time_utc - operational_lag. For an issue time of ~22:00 UTC Oct 3 on data ending 00:00 UTC Oct 3, the serving cutoff is ~2h for currents and 0h for waves.
governance_rules.era5t_reanalysis_revision_warning: ERA5T data for the latest active month is provisional and subject to revision by ECMWF.
governance_rules.model_tide_caveat: Tidal velocities (utide, vtide) represent 1/12 degree numerical model physics at the 6.86 km offshore cell (13.6667N, 120.8333E), not an in-situ pier tide gauge.
